Name: Natural Beauties
Author: MangusuPixel
Description:
This mod aims to offer skimpy/nude portraits with more natural and modest bust sizes. I intend on keeping this a long-term project, adding more characters, optional body edits, support with other mods, and lewd clothing edits.

[size=4]Portrait Display[/size]
A display-altering mod is required because the portrait images are taller than the originals (to show, well, the important bits...). Here are the supported display mods:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22678]Dialogue Display Framework[/url]﻿ (recommended) - places taller portraits in a custom portrait frame, making it look as closely as possible to the base game. It also adds an option to refresh content packs with the F5 key, to refresh portraits after changing mod settings.﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] to fit taller portraits in the default portrait frame or above the dialogue window. It also allows quick changing between portraits by pressing the P key to quickly switch between edits and other mods. However, you'll have to extract the assets yourself for now.
[*]Know of another mod? Please let me know and I'll do my best to add support.
[/list]
[size=4]Features
[/size][list]
[*]Extended topless portraits for all bachelorettes.
[*]Extended topless portraits for other characters (Currently, only Marnie)
[/list]
[size=4]Planned Features[/size]
[list]
[*]Fully support alternative hairstyle/headwear for beach/winter portraits.
[*]Portraits for Caroline, Jodi, Robin and Sandy.
[*]Outfit edits that get unlocked by friendship level for all supported characters.
[*]UI to toggle outfit edits and nudity on/off.
[*]Accepting commission requests for alternative poses, outfits, or custom character portraits.
[/list]
[size=4]Technical[/size]
[list]
[*]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Changelogs can be found ﻿in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20552?tab=logs]logs tab[/url].
[/list]
[size=4]Support
[/size]If you have issues, suggestions, or feedback, comment here or join my Discord for a quicker response. If you like my mods, donating is the best way to show appreciation while supporting both me and future updates.
